title: FBA fulfillment fee increase, 2026
category: FBA fulfillment — size tier, weight and price dependent
source_title: Update to U.S. Referral and Fulfillment by Amazon fees for 2026
summary: FBA fulfillment fees increase by an announced average of $0.08 per unit sold, less than 0.5% of an average item's selling price. Actual change varies by size tier, weight and price; no per-tier old/new values are recorded.

conditions: Announced average, not a universal rate; actual change varies by size tier, weight and price.
No per-tier old/new values are recorded.
Unless otherwise noted, changes take effect January 15, 2026.
evidence_details.linkage_reason: No current-record link; an announced average does not establish a per-tier current rate.

references.title: 2026 FBA fee increase — announced average
references.quote: In 2026, FBA fees will increase by an average of $0.08 per unit sold, or less than 0.5% of an average item's selling price. This is on top of no increase in US Referral and FBA fees in 2025.

references.title: 2026 FBA changes — effective date
references.quote: Unless otherwise noted, all changes will be effective January 15, 2026.
